{{Quote|I&hellip; I am certain that the Emperor has a plan, commander. We will discuss it upon your return to Coruscant&hellip;''"<br />"''Yes, my lord. But I'm not sure ''when'' the regiment and I will be back&ndash; our transport was ''re-tasked'' by order of the Emperor.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and Commander Vill|<ref name="Dark Times 2" />}}
A '''regiment''' of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was under the leadership of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vill]] and was dispatched by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] to put down the local [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurin]] [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|New Plympto resistance]] as part of a [[Unidentified brigade (501st Legion)|brigade]]. The [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] was supported by [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]] and [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tanks]]. It was supported by at least two [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]].<ref name="Dark Times 2" />
